Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: At this step, WebSurfer extracted and treated Wikipedia’s “Bellevue, Ohio” birthplace for John Francis Dillon as authoritative without resolving clear conflicts from other credible sources (e.g., IMDb listing New York City). This premature reliance on an inconsistent Wikipedia snapshot led the process toward the wrong birthplace instead of the correct answer, New York.
